method_notes: Weighted quarter-final and knockout performances most heavily as the best signal of current form, with group-stage dominance and historical big-match pedigree as tiebreakers. Favoured teams winning comfortably in 90 minutes over those needing late goals or penalties.

predictions.reasoning: France have been the tournament's most complete side with a 2-0 quarter-final win and no goals conceded in the knockouts until now, edging a Spain team that has been efficient but less dominant.
Argentina's attack has scored three in every knockout game while England have needed narrow wins each round, so Argentina's firepower should edge a tight match.
